checks.name: Static RTL review
checks.details: Exact TopModule interface; one-bit unsigned ports; continuous combinational assignments; no state, clock, reset, latency, or inferred latches. SOP uses two product terms and five literals; POS uses three sum factors and five literals.

checks.name: Icarus development compile
checks.details: Requested Icarus v12 executable, -g2012 -Wall -s dev_tb, finite 20-second timeout; compile.log contains no diagnostics.

checks.name: Independent exhaustive development simulation
checks.details: Matching vvp executable with finite 20-second timeout; all 12 specified inputs passed and both expressions agreed on all 16 binary inputs. Testbench includes its own timeout.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed development checks without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was preserved before checks; candidate.sv remains unchanged.
